summary: Roma Green Finance Ltd filed Form 6-K on June 23, 2026, announcing a non-binding letter of intent to acquire a 5% equity interest in NXTGrid Compute Power Inc. for US$15 million, as well as updates on previous non-binding LOIs for a 5% stake in BlueFlare Group Holdings Inc. for US$15 million, a right of first offer for project-level funding, and the establishment of an AI/HPC infrastructure investment vertical. No definitive agreements are reported, no board recommendation or advisors are named, and no binding transaction terms, premium, or close date are disclosed. As these are preliminary non-binding letters of intent without binding deal terms, this is not a definitive special situation; it is a routine foreign private issuer report.
